subject: general
question: Which among the following Articles of Indian Constitution is related to Gram Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 243A**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Article of the Indian Constitution related to the **Gram Sabha** is **Article 243A**.
 
• This **article defines the composition and powers of the Gram Sabha**, which is the assembly of the villagers in a Panchayati Raj system at the village level.
 
• It **empowers the Gram Sabha to approve plans for economic development and social justice,** and it has the authority to make recommendations to the Panchayat regarding the implementation of these plans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 244A:
 
 
• It provides for the establishment of Autonomous District Councils in certain areas of Assam and Manipur, allowing these councils to have legislative, administrative, and financial powers to address the unique needs of the local populace.
 
 
 
• Article 245B:
 
 
• It grants the Parliament the power to make laws for the Union Territories and empowers the Legislative Assembly of a Union Territory to make laws for the areas under its jurisdiction, provided such laws do not conflict with the existing central laws.
 
 
 
• Article 242B:
 
 
• It is not a valid article in the Indian Constitution; however, Article 242 pertains to the establishment of Panchayats in Scheduled Areas and outlines the applicability of provisions of Part IX of the Constitution to these areas.
